run_test_label_smoothing: run the unittest test suite for label smoothed cross entropy criterion in fairseq
test_nll_loss: test that the NLL loss from label smoothed criterion matches standard cross entropy criterion
test_padding: test that label smoothed cross entropy criterion handles padded batch items correctly
test_reduction: test that reduced and unreduced loss values are consistent for label smoothed cross entropy
test_zero_eps: test that label smoothed cross entropy with zero smoothing equals standard cross entropy loss
